response.summary: Overall quality is below the expected standard: while the basic train/test split and preprocessing pipeline are set up correctly, the analysis has major issues in reliability and reporting. The most important finding is an integrity mismatch: the written conclusion claims a test AUC of 0.721, but the notebook’s actual outputs show ~0.714 (and can drop to ~0.705 on another run), so the headline result is not supported by the code. The results are also not reproducible because the train/test split has no fixed random seed, and the data-cleaning description overstates what is handled (dates are parsed with only one format and rows that fail parsing are silently dropped without quantifying impact). In interview, ask the candidate to (1) reproduce the reported metrics with a fixed random_state, (2) explain and quantify how many rows were dropped during cleaning and why, and (3) address the very low recall at the default 0.5 threshold and what they would do to choose an operating threshold.
